connector.name: GetExperience
connector.registryDescription: Search and book tours and travel experiences in 40+ countries via MCP.
connector.summary: Hosted at getexperience.com over server sent events. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 7 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the skurakov account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
